attribution.title: Former Kweekschool voor Machinisten, Plantage Muidergracht 14, Amsterdam (A. Salm 1886-87; B.J. Ouendag 1926; W.B. Ouendag 1934)
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012164973 (CC0): Salm's red-brown street front with its sandstone speklagen, segmental window arches over brick-mosaic tympana, the two raised risalits with the 1878 and 1887 gable stones, the director's wing with its stone balcony on consoles and the two heads, the 1934 portico wing, B.J. Ouendag's 1926 block, the 1934 block, and the canal side with its stair towers, lab wing and red sun blinds, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0) and the municipal monument register (CC0). No pixels or meshes imported.
